text: Working on it: a required flag option (`is_flag=True, required=True`) currently doesn't raise "Missing option '--flag'" because `Option.__init__` forces the default to `False`, so the value never counts as missing. I've started a subagent to fix `src/click/core.py` and verify against the full test suite; ETA ~15 min.

Got it — second bug (echo with no streams attached: `_default_text_stdout`/`_default_text_stderr` must yield None and `echo` must not blow up). A subagent is on it now; ETA ~20 min. First bug (required flag) is still in progress.

Bug #1 fixed and verified. Cause: in `Option.__init__` (src/click/core.py) a flag option with no explicit default got `default = False` unconditionally, so `value_is_missing()` never reported it missing and `required=True` was silently ignored. Fix: only apply that default when the option is not required (1-line change, line ~2519). Now `--flag` required with no args exits 2 with "Missing option '--flag'", while `--flag` given still yields True and non-required flags keep defaulting to False. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — identical to baseline (baseline had zero failures), so nothing regressed.
#1 is done: required flag options now raise "Missing option '--flag'" (fix in src/click/core.py), full test suite unchanged at 488 passed / 21 skipped / 1 xfailed.
#2 (echo with no streams attached) is in progress: the fix in _compat.py/_termui_impl.py/utils.py is being written and the full suite re-run. ETA ~12 min.

#4 noted: an option that is a flag with an explicit `flag_value` should use that flag value when its envvar is set (instead of the raw env string). A subagent is investigating src/click/core.py and will fix + verify it; ETA ~18 min. #2 is still in progress.

#5 noted: applying `@click.argument(...)` (and `@click.option(...)`) multiple times must preserve a custom Argument/Option subclass instead of downgrading it to the plain class. A subagent is on src/click/decorators.py now; ETA ~18 min. #2 and #4 still in progress.

Bug #2 fixed and verified. Cause: `_make_cached_stream_func` (src/click/_compat.py) called the text-stream wrapper even when `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr`/`sys.stdin` were None (pythonw on Windows), and `echo()` then wrote to None → AttributeError. Fix: the default-stream helpers now return None when the underlying sys stream is None (annotations made Optional), `echo()` returns early instead of writing, and `ProgressBar`/`pager` in _termui_impl.py fall back to os.devnull. So `click.echo(...)` (stdout and stderr, text and bytes), `echo_via_pager(...)` and `progressbar(...)` no longer raise when no streams are attached. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — same as baseline, no regressions.
#1 done (required flag now errors with "Missing option '--flag'"; suite unchanged).
#2 done (echo/echo_via_pager/progressbar no longer crash when no std streams are attached; suite unchanged).
#4 (flag_value + envvar) still in progress: subagent is working in src/click/core.py; ETA ~10 min.
#5 (custom Argument/Option subclass preserved when decorators are applied multiple times) still in progress in src/click/decorators.py; ETA ~12 min.

#7 noted: `click.Path(resolve_path=True)` mishandles symlinks — it does a single `os.readlink` (raw, possibly relative target, resolved against CWD) before `realpath`, so relative/multi-level symlinks resolve wrong. A subagent is fixing src/click/types.py and verifying; ETA ~15 min. #4 and #5 still in progress.

Bug #4 fixed and verified. Cause: `Option.consume_value` used the raw envvar string for a non-boolean flag (option with explicit `flag_value`), so `FLAG=1` gave "1" instead of the flag value. Fix: when `is_flag and not is_bool_flag` and the value came from the environment, use `self.flag_value` (boolean flags still parse the envvar as a bool; empty/unset envvar still falls back to the default). Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — same as baseline, no regressions.

Bug #7 fixed and verified. Cause: `Path.convert` with `resolve_path=True` did `os.readlink()` (raw target, possibly relative, resolved against CWD) then `os.path.realpath()`, so relative and multi-level symlinks resolved incorrectly. Fix: resolve via `pathlib.Path(os.fsdecode(rv)).resolve()` (handles symlinks in every component, chains, and relative targets; also covers Windows < 3.8), re-encoding to bytes when the input was bytes so bytes-in/bytes-out and `path_type` coercion are preserved. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — same as baseline, no regressions.

#8 noted: `Context.default_map` is ignored for flags (Option.get_default's non-bool-flag branch never consults `ctx.default_map`). A subagent is fixing src/click/core.py and verifying; ETA ~12 min. #5 is still in progress.

Bug #5 fixed and verified. Cause: `argument()` in src/click/decorators.py did `attrs.pop("cls", Argument)` on the decorator's own closure dict, so a second application of the same decorator silently fell back to plain `click.Argument` (the sibling `option()` already copies attrs for issue 926). Fix: copy the attrs before popping `cls`, so a custom Argument subclass is preserved on every use. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — same as baseline, no regressions.
#1 done (required flag now errors with "Missing option '--flag'").
#2 done (echo/echo_via_pager/progressbar safe when no std streams attached).
#4 done (non-boolean flag uses its flag_value when the envvar is set).
#5 done (argument decorator keeps a custom Argument subclass when used repeatedly).
#7 done (Path(resolve_path=True) now resolves symlinks correctly via pathlib).
#8 (default_map for flags) is still in progress in src/click/core.py; ETA ~8 min.
